clarifications.question: The planned outage list names sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/9 to Gi1/0/12, but only Gi1/0/9 and Gi1/0/10 are shut down (both recorded as baseline deltas). Are Gi1/0/11 and Gi1/0/12 meant to be shut for the Unit 2 window, or should they stay active?

The approved trunks sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 {10,99} and Gi1/0/24 {10,20,30,99} carry VLAN 10, while the rule says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10. Should these approved uplink trunks be treated as exceptions to that rule?

rtr-01 has a second default route (0.0.0.0/0 via 10.10.99.1, the fw-01 mgmt interface) alongside the ISP default via 198.51.100.1, and it has a leg in MGMT (GigabitEthernet0, 10.10.99.12). Is this route intended? EDGE_IN denies Internet traffic to 10.10.x.x in the current evidence, but the registry does not say whether a default route into MGMT is allowed.
